name: drut
description: Syntax highlighting and language support for Cube Voyager control-statement scripts (.s/.block), backed by the Drut language server.

semanticTokenTypes.description: A self-closing short-IF, distinguished from a block-style IF (spec.md FR-016).
A generic base type for a whole-statement span carrying only a modifier (e.g. unreachable) — this feature declares no general-syntax token types of its own.

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A statement that can never execute because it follows a BREAK validly resolved as inside its enclosing loop (spec.md FR-017).

drut.format.casing.markdownDescription: Legacy keyword-casing convention, applied to control words and pair keywords only (021-editor-settings-config). Left unset (no default declared here) means "consult a project's `drut.toml`, then the built-in default." A workspace `drut.toml` setting for the same category always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.controlWordsCasing.markdownDescription: Casing convention for control-word keywords (e.g. `IF`/`ENDIF`/`LOOP`) — wins over `drut.format.casing` for this category specifically when both are set. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.pairKeywordsCasing.markdownDescription: Casing convention for pair keywords — wins over `drut.format.casing` for this category specifically when both are set. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.dataReferencesCasing.markdownDescription: Casing convention for data-reference tokens (Matrix/Line/Node/Zone/Database abbreviations, output-record and link-endpoint tokens, and the two reserved loop-index identifiers) — not reachable by `drut.format.casing` at all. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.topLevelIndent.markdownDescription: Top-level (depth-0) indentation policy — `preserve` leaves it exactly as written; `normalize` forces every top-level line to column 0. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.indentWidth.markdownDescription: Spaces per nesting level of block indentation. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.operatorSpacing.markdownDescription: Whitespace normalization around operators/commas/bracket-paren interiors — `preserve` leaves it exactly as written; `fixed` normalizes to one space each side of every recognized operator; `auto` does everything `fixed` does plus vertically aligning consecutive assignment statements' `=`. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.blankLines.markdownDescription: Whether/how excessive blank-line runs are contracted — `preserve` leaves every run exactly as written; `auto` contracts a run down to the applicable cap (see `drut.format.topLevelBlankLineCap`/`drut.format.nestedBlankLineCap`) only when it exceeds that cap. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.topLevelBlankLineCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines `auto` allows between top-level statements/blocks before contracting the run. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

drut.format.nestedBlankLineCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines `auto` allows inside any block's own body, uniformly regardless of nesting depth, before contracting the run. A workspace `drut.toml` setting for this field always wins over this personal setting.

scripts.test: ts-node test/grammar.test.ts && ts-node test/formatOnSave.test.ts && ts-node test/binaryBootstrap.test.ts
